CONSULTANCY AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is dated 3 March 2026 and made between Fenwick Advisory Ltd (the "Consultant") and Orrin Logistics plc (the "Client").

1. Interpretation
1.1 In this Agreement:
"Assignment" means the project described in Schedule 1;
"Fee" means GBP 900 per day (fictional);
"Deliverables" means the reports produced in the Assignment;
"Expenses" means reasonable travel costs approved in advance;
"Fee" means the fee set out in the Statement of Work.
1.2 Clause headings do not affect interpretation.

2. Services
2.1 The Consultant shall perform the Assignment with reasonable skill and care.
2.2 The Consultant shall deliver the deliverables by the Completion Date.
2.3 The Client shall pay the Fee within 30 days of invoice, subject to clause 6 (Set-off).

3. Intellectual property
3.1 The Deliverables belong to the Client on payment.
3.3 The Consultant keeps its Background IP.

5. Termination
5.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement on one month's notice.
5.2 Clauses 3 and 7 survive termination.

Schedule 1 The Assignment
A review of warehouse routing (fictional).

# LOAN NOTE INSTRUMENT (fictional)

This instrument is made by Kestrel Ventures Ltd (the "Issuer").

## 1. Definitions

1.1 "Noteholder" means a person registered as the holder of a Note.

1.2 "Note" means a loan note issued under this instrument.

1.3 "Maturity Date" means 30 June 2029.

## 2. Interest

2.1 Each Note bears interest at 8% a year, payable on each Interest Payment Date.

2.2 Interest accrues from the date of issue.

2.2 Interest is paid gross.

## 3. Redemption

3.1 The Issuer shall redeem the Notes on the maturity date.

3.2 The Issuer may redeem early in the events listed in Schedule 2:

(a) a change of control;

(b) a listing; or

(d) a sale of the business.

3.3 Early redemption is at par, as provided in paragraph 3 of Schedule 2.

## Schedule 2 Early Redemption Events

1. A change of control of the Issuer.

2. A listing of the Issuer's shares.

MASTER CONSULTING AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Master Consulting Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into by Brightline Data, Inc. ("Brightline") and Calder Mutual Insurance Company ("Calder").

Section 1. Definitions
1.1 "Work Order" means an order for services in the form of Exhibit A.
1.2 "Confidential Information" has the meaning given in Section 4.1.

Section 2. Services
2.1 Brightline shall perform the services described in each Work Order.
2.2 Each Work Order is governed by this Agreement.

Section 3. Fees
3.1 Calder shall pay the fees set out in each Work Order within 30 days of invoice.

Section 4. Confidentiality
4.1 Each party shall protect the other party's confidential information ("Confidential Information") with reasonable care.
4.2 Section 4.1 survives for three years.
